business_problem: improve data reliability and self-service access across route planning, finance, training, and marketing so the agency could manage service growth and rider experience with shared facts.
solution_summary: Community Transit uses Snowflake on Snowflake to improve data reliability and self-service access across route planning, finance, training, and marketing so the agency could manage service growth and rider experience with shared facts. Ridership, route, apts, and operational data are centralized in Snowflake so planning, finance, and service teams can work from a faster, more reliable operating view. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and governed access on one platform reduces handoffs, simplifies operations, and makes it easier to reuse trusted data across analytics, reporting, and AI. Community Transit achieved 77% Less time to process 5x more transportation data.
